gen-dafont-joystix-gf-comme: Bold and arcade-loud up top, Joystix is widely tracked and barely varies in stroke; Comme below it is smooth, modern and easy on curves. Its lowercase fills nearly the whole letter height.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads as a plain sans with a wide-eyed e and a prominent x-height, so every word feels open. Over a full page it would stay steady and unfussy, a quiet counterweight to the arcade-style Joystix.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-duru-sans: Joystix comes in widely tracked and arcade-bold, its horizontals a notch lighter than its uprights. Duru Sans answers with wide openings on small letters and big lowercase bodies, which gives the pair its strongest quality: loud and friendly at once.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-fresca: Modern and clean, Fresca has stems like dowels and arcs like bent dowels, set against the arcade swagger of Joystix. Its connected counters keep a long stretch of text moving.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-funnel-sans: A faint stone-carved heft change runs through the widely tracked, arcade-bold Joystix, and it gives the headings real character. Funnel Sans brings the opposite: sans-serif curves as thin and constant as a drawn thread, which is the pair's sharpest difference.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-gafata: Joystix is all arcade nerve, widely tracked with a slight pen-like shift in weight. Gafata sits beneath it as a tall band of sans-serif letters with wide-eyed e shapes, and the two make a sharp, readable contrast.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-geist: Widely tracked and arcade-bold, Joystix barely presses its strokes, like a round brush with a light touch on the page. Geist then settles in with solid word blocks and no accents of weight.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-georama: Joystix leads with arcade boldness, widely tracked and softly contrasted, never flat or stark, in a way that grabs attention at once. Georama follows with a pulled-apart c and low capitals, easy going.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-gidole: Gidole keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades and draws each stroke with a neon-tube consistency, a high midline included. Joystix, bold and widely tracked above it, supplies the heavier arcade punch.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-golos-text: Joystix is widely tracked and arcade-bold, with a gradual weight change instead of a sudden snap. And Golos Text, with its x-height filling the line and one flat stroke width, makes the strongest contrast.
